# Per-link click analytics dashboard

Gives a link owner a small dashboard: total clicks, a daily trend, and the top
referrers. Reads the counters and event log; it never mutates link state.

## Panels

- **Headline** — lifetime clicks for the code.
- **Trend** — clicks per day over a selectable window.
- **Referrers** — top source hosts, truncated to a sane list.

## Windows

| Window   | Buckets   | Default |
| -------- | --------- | ------- |
| 7 days   | daily     | yes     |
| 30 days  | daily     | no      |
| 12 weeks | weekly    | no      |

## Reference

```python
from snip.web.analytics import daily_series

series = daily_series(code="a7Kd93Q", window_days=7)
render("analytics.html", code=code, series=series)
```

Referrer hosts are grouped by registrable domain so `m.example.com` and
`www.example.com` collapse into one row[^ref].

[^ref]: Grouping by full host fragments the top-referrer list and buries the real
    source; the public-suffix collapse keeps the panel legible.
